description: List the available recipe prompts (slug, title, description). Call this BEFORE writing or generating a video script when the user's request describes a topic rather than a ready script — news of the day, a real place with its own photos, a concrete subject like a car or a product, GitHub pull requests, or first-time account setup. Then call get_prompt with the matching slug to load the full validated workflow for that recipe.
name: list_prompts
